Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of BAC.
Our gross margin expanded by 23 basis points to 21.4%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 23 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2022.
We delivered record revenue of $13.7 billion this quarter, representing 7% year-over-year growth.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1664 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 7% to 22% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
